facts.text: Tento druh se živil gekony a šneky.
facts.quote: the Rodrigues night heron fed on snails as well as the geckos

facts.text: Tento druh dobře běhal a létal jen zřídka.
facts.quote: was adapted to running, and although able to fly, rarely did so

facts.text: Tento druh žil jen na ostrově Rodrigues v Indickém oceánu.
facts.quote: endemic to the Mascarene island of Rodrigues in the Indian Ocean

facts.text: Tento druh byl velmi krotký a nebál se lidí.
facts.quote: the bird was very tame and confiding, and not afraid of humans

facts.text: Tento druh nejspíš hnízdil na zemi nebo v nízkých keřích.
facts.quote: it probably nested on the ground or in low bushes

facts.text: Tento druh nejspíš vyhynul kvůli lidem, například kvůli zavlečení koček.
facts.quote: it is thought to have been driven to extinction by human-related factors such as the introduction of cats
